summary: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional (NYSE: SID) furnished a 6-K reporting a binding term sheet, dated October 9, 2026, with Bipadosa S.L., holding company of Spain's Megasa group, for the sale of all shares of German long-steel unit Stahlwerk Thüringen GmbH (SWT), a US-equivalent asset sale/disposition. Terms: enterprise value €550 million subject to adjustments, plus up to 10 weeks of exclusivity; definitive agreements and customary conditions precedent still required. No board recommendation or advisor named. Sale advances CSN's divestment program to cut leverage. Watch definitive-agreement execution, price adjustments, and any antitrust review.
